preface.title: Preface
preface.para: This book is a collection of recipes for ooRexx/.NET, the bridge between Open Object Rexx and .NET. Each recipe starts from something you want to do, gives a complete program that does it, shows what the program prints, and explains how it works. Read the first chapter first; the others in any order.

Every program that does not need Windows is run, and its output checked, by the project's tests on Linux, macOS and Windows, so what you read is what the bridge does. Programs that need Windows say so; those that open windows or need Office are shown without their output.

Its companion, ooRexx and .NET: Reference, describes every class and method, and the rules behind the recipes; each recipe ends with the sections of the reference to read next. .NET's own classes are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/.
